title: Signal-anchored rollback storyboard and micro-circuit editor
creator: Marisol Gomez
description:
Overview: Design a compact, signal-driven rollback storyboard and a lightweight 'micro-circuit' visual editor that lets SREs and PMs declare rollback conditions as small composable blocks. The goal is to make rollback decisions explainable, testable, and quickly executable from the Redwood Console rollout flow.

Problem statement: Current rollback flows are implicit and require jumping between dashboards, runbooks, and alerts. Teams want a single surface to author safety rules tied to signals (latency, error rate, throughput, hallucination signals), preview their effect on traffic, and simulate emergency rollback scenarios without leaving the rollout composer.

Scope: This ticket covers high-fidelity storyboard frames, an interactive micro-circuit editor prototype (Figma + HTML prototype), edge-case flows for signal conflicts, and a short moderated usability test plan. Implementation handoff artifacts and engineering constraints are included in attachments.
acceptance_criteria:
- Designers produce a Figma prototype with 6 interactive frames demonstrating: authoring a micro-circuit, binding signals, previewing traffic impact, triggering an automated rollback, and manual escalation.
- Prototype includes a simulated signal timeline and a visual trace showing why a rollback would be triggered.
- UX copy for safety-critical modals reviewed by PM and SRE.
- Handoff doc with component specs (inputs, validation, accessibility notes) and a prioritized engineering checklist accepted by ENG.
- Usability test (n=6) completed with defined metrics (task success, time on task, perceived trust) and a summary of at most three actionable UI changes.
discussion: 2026-02-06 - Marisol: Initial problem framing added. Noted the need to support both binary (on/off) and threshold rules for signals.
2026-02-12 - Kai: Sketched micro-circuit primitives: Source (signal), Transform (threshold/aggregation), Gate (AND/OR), Action (rollback/manual-alert). Shared Figma starter board.
2026-02-18 - PM (Liam Chen): Requested explicit audit trail visible in the playback view (who/when/which signal). Prioritize this for compliance customers.

2026-02-25 - Eng (Priya Singh): Flagged backend constraint: we can only evaluate rollbacks against sampled metrics with 5s cadence in Dedicated; will affect live preview fidelity. Added ENG-44512 as dependency.
2026-03-03 - Marisol: Iterated on error-state UX where two conflicting rules would both fire. Proposed conflict resolution modal with suggested auto-priority rules and a 'test-run' toggle.
2026-03-08 - Design review: Feedback from Design lead (Sofia Ruiz): simplify visual language for micro-circuit nodes, reduce color palette, ensure colorblind-safe shapes are present.
2026-03-10 - Kai: Prototype updated with playback timeline and 'explain' overlay; moving to In Review and requesting engineering input on performance characteristics for simulation mode.
decisions: Use a micro-circuit metaphor (nodes and wires) rather than a freeform rule JSON editor to lower cognitive load for non-technical PMs.
Support three canonical signal primitives at launch: latency P95, error rate (5xx%), and model-quality regressions (embedding drift / hallucination score). Other signals via 'custom metric' node.
Preview will run against a sampled historical dataset (30m window) for deterministic playback rather than live production streams to avoid side effects.
Make audit trail visible in playback and final rollout snapshot; include a compact changelog entry when an automated rollback happens.
review_feedback: Design review (2026-03-08): Reduce node label verbosity; prefer single-line labels plus tooltip.
Security review request (2026-03-09): PM asked whether rollback actions require explicit 2-step confirmation for high-impact deployments. Deferred to PM for policy decision.
Engineering review (2026-03-10): Simulation mode must be opt-in to avoid accidental load on metrics ingestion; agreed to implement sampling safeguards.
next_steps: Incorporate review feedback into Figma prototype and export component spec sheet (by 2026-03-14).
Schedule a 30-minute handoff with ENG owners (Priya, Ravi) to align on observable contracts (metrics API, evaluation cadence).
Run moderated usability sessions with two SREs and four PMs during cycle 2026-W11 and iterate on top 3 pain points.
Create a small HTML prototype (no backend) demonstrating drag-to-connect and playback explain overlay for dev preview.
